answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can be grounded in proof-of-stake enrollment gated by a verifiable delay function, so each identity must burn real capital and sequential work before it can register at dawn. This turns identity creation from a cheap fable into a costly commitment layered over a shale-like ledger of bonded collateral, where reputation accrues only. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
